current_grouping: Subpart E — Power-Plant Installations; Reciprocating Engines

versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart E — Power-Plant Installations; Reciprocating Engines
versions.text: If the engine is equipped with an oil filter, the filter shall be constructed and installed in such a manner that complete blocking of the flow through the filter element will not jeopardize the continued operation of the engine oil supply system.
